verdict.rationale: Ramp exposes a broad programmatic surface. The OpenAPI spec documents 174 paths, OAuth scopes span transactions, bills, cards, banking and applications, and bill payments can run end-to-end via the API. A CLI with 12 resources and an MCP server with dozens of read/write scopes add agent channels. However, no source claims UI parity, and the docs name gaps: bill approvals aren't available via MCP ("use the Ramp UI"), partner-prefilled applications must be finished in the Ramp UI, and incorporation is private-preview only. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity guarantee, account sign-up completable via API, full parity across channels (e.g. bill approvals in MCP), and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
